title: Cosmological Singularities and Quantum Particles
summary: We study if there is an opportunity to describe quantum particles in the vicinity of three types of cosmological singularities, big bang-big crunch, big rip and big brake. Writing down the Dirac equation for spinors, and choosing a convenient parametrization for basis functions of the spinor field, we show that the corresponding second-order differential equation has two independent solutions which are non-singular in the case of all three types of singularities.
